title: MarketHaven SMP
description: MarketHaven SMP is a Market Economy Minecraft SMP! We are chill players who engage in trade, build businesses, and create settlements. Unlike other economy servers, we prioritize on the economy side as well as having fun with other players rather than PvP.
body: **MarketHaven SMP** is a Market Economy Minecraft SMP! We are chill players who engage in **trade**, build b**usinesses**, and create **towns**. Unlike other economy servers, we **prioritize the economy side** rather than PvP. We also host events to keep our players engaged. Join us now at **markethavensmp.playit.plus**
